description: This Java interface 'CreditBasedSender' defines a client component for managing message sending based on flow control credits, including methods to retrieve current credit and set a handler for when capacity is available.

classes.name: CreditBasedSender
classes.description: An interface for a sender that manages flow control credits and allows registering a handler to be notified when capacity is available.

methods.name: getCredit
methods.description: Returns the current number of messages the sender can send based on available credits.

methods.name: sendQueueDrainHandler
methods.description: Registers a handler to be invoked once the sender has capacity to send messages again, i.e., when credits are replenished.
